'''Hakkun Re Hanuther''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. By [[3643 BBY]], Re Hanuther was serving as the resident advisor in the [[Tetan Royal Palace/Legends|Tetan Royal Palace]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was infected with a plague by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Parkanas Tark|Vivicar]]. However, Re Hanuther was freed when Vivicar was defeated.<ref name="Casualty List" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hakkun Re Hanuther was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in a message to [[Jedi Consular]] players after end of Act I if they chose to allow [[Terrak Morrhage]] to kill the Jedi Masters connected to him.<ref name="Casualty List" />
